title: rate
intro:
Specify a rate or a halftime.
    Used by AOM component turnover (see 8, page 53) , SMB component turnover
(see 13, page 65) , and SOM component turnover (see 14, page 67) .

sections.name: halftime
sections.desc: A rate specified through the equivalent halftime (rate = ln 2 / halftime).
